title: MCPToolDefinition
description: Standard Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool definition schema

name.description: Unique identifier of the tool within the connector

description.description: Human and LLM-readable description of what the tool does

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema object describing the parameters accepted by the tool

outputSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema describing the expected structure of tool output

isDangerous.description: Whether executing this tool produces side-effects or mutations requiring user confirmation
